name: chainpe-wallet
display_name: ChainPe — Arc Testnet Wallet for AI Agents
description: Arc Testnet wallet for Claude. Discover ChainPe services on-chain and pay for them with x402 USDC — no API keys, no accounts.
long_description:
Give Claude an Arc Testnet wallet wired into the ChainPe marketplace. ChainPe adds tools for:

- **search_bazaar** — Discover x402-gated services from the ChainPe on-chain registry
- **x402_fetch** — Fetch a service URL with automatic x402 payment handling
- **check_balance** — View your USDC balance (USDC is also the gas token) and wallet address
- **pay** — Sign an x402 payment authorization (USDC on Arc Testnet)
- **transfer_usdc** — Send USDC to any address
- **spending_report** — Review what the agent has spent today
- **request_funding** — Generate an EIP-681 top-up link

Use your wallet private key to pay with USDC on Arc Testnet.

Budget limits protect your funds: set max per call and max per day.

private_key.title: Wallet Private Key (0x…)
private_key.description: Your wallet private key. Used to sign x402 USDC payments on Arc Testnet. Stored securely in your OS keychain.

network.title: Default Network
network.description: Payment network: arc-testnet (the only supported network).

max_per_call.title: Max USDC per Payment
max_per_call.description: Maximum USDC allowed per single payment. Safety limit.

max_per_day.title: Max USDC per Day
max_per_day.description: Maximum total USDC allowed per calendar day.

chainpe_registry_address.title: ChainPe Registry Address
chainpe_registry_address.description: Address of the ChainPeRegistry contract on Arc Testnet. Leave blank unless you run your own registry.

erc8004_reputation_registry.title: ERC-8004 Reputation Registry
erc8004_reputation_registry.description: Address of the ERC-8004 Reputation Registry. Used to read provider scores and post feedback on-chain. Leave blank to use the default for the network.

tools.name: search_bazaar
tools.description: Discover x402-gated services on the ChainPe on-chain registry. Returns name, price, tags, and endpoint.

tools.name: x402_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a service URL with automatic x402 payment. Handles 402 responses by signing the USDC payment and retrying.

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Check the USDC balance (also the gas token on Arc) and wallet address on the configured network.

tools.name: pay
tools.description: Sign an x402 USDC payment authorization. Returns the payment header value.

tools.name: transfer_usdc
tools.description: Send USDC on-chain to any address.

tools.name: spending_report
tools.description: Show how much USDC the agent has spent today and the configured limits.

tools.name: request_funding
tools.description: Generate an EIP-681 link to top up the wallet with USDC.

tools.name: give_feedback
tools.description: Post an on-chain ERC-8004 reputation score (0–100) for a service provider's agent.
